name: Miki Miki Academy
source:
Our protagonist has gone to his new school Miki Miki Academy, which he has heard is an amazing school. He meets two girls whom he becomes friends with.
Mio, a kind girl who gave the new student a tour around their school.
Sukoii, a girl who finds fun often and enjoys to wear cat ears.
translation:
主人公来到听说非常棒的新学校——米奇米奇学院。在那里，他结识了两个女孩，并和她们成为朋友。

美绪是一位善良的女孩，带着转校生参观了学校。

斯可伊是一位总能找到乐趣、喜欢戴猫耳的女孩。
